statement: A Summoning condition ("Cannot be Special Summoned", "Must (first) be Special Summoned by ...", "Must be Special Summoned with ..."), a way of Summoning a monster that its text adds to the rules' ("You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing ...", "you can also Xyz Summon this card by ...") and what an Equip Spell can equip ("Equip only to ...") aren't treated as effects: negating the card's effects doesn't lift them, and nothing copies them (kind CONDITION, on the effect or on the summon).

sources.name: Vidolium the Unstable Power Patron of Unity
sources.says: Its "Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned ... by returning 3 monsters ..." isn't treated as an effect: it is how this monster is Special Summoned (効果として扱いません。このモンスターの特殊召喚の方法・手順です。). Gem-Knight Seraphinite's FAQ (card 10000, 0.5, 2024-11-23) says the same of "must first be Fusion Summoned", and Artmage Non-Finito's (0.5) of its Summoning condition (read by Claude, 2026-11-20, from db-ygoresources-com/yugioh-faq-history).

sources.name: Clown Crew Biancaviso
sources.says: Its "You can Tribute Summon this card face-up by Tributing 1 Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum or Link Monster" isn't treated as an effect: it is how this card is Tribute Summoned (効果として扱いません。このカードをアドバンス召喚する方法です). Of the FAQs of cards whose English text says "You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing" and that class it, 26 say the same (Behemoth the King of All Animals, the Mega Monarchs, The Great Gallant Bandit) and one, Pyrotech Mech - Shiryu's, calls it unclassified (special-summon-and-no-tribute-procedures-are-unclassified). Super Starslayer TY-PHON - Sky Crisis's FAQ (card 19184, 0.5) says the same of its "you can also Xyz Summon this card" (read by Claude, 2026-11-21).

sources.name: Dark Energy
sources.says: "Equip only to a Fiend monster." isn't treated as an effect: it is the condition of the monster this card equips (効果として扱いません。このカードを装備するモンスターの条件です。). 16 Equip Spells' FAQs say the same.

scripts: The scripts give a Summoning condition (EFFECT_SPSUMMON_CONDITION) CANNOT_DISABLE and UNCOPYABLE, as RML does. aux.AddEquipProcedure gives EQUIP_LIMIT only CANNOT_DISABLE: an equip limit is never copied, so the missing UNCOPYABLE changes nothing.
